<!-- Source page: Deployment workgroup -->

This is an informal gathering of people interesting in deploying Nix(OS) onto various targets like bare-metal, cloud, containers, … Following NixCon and other informal discussions there are quite a few people working in that area. The goal is to bring people together on the subject so that we don’t re-invent the wheel in our corners. It might also allow us to work towards bigger goals that any individual might not be able to tackle in his own.

Everyone interested is welcome to join it as this is not an official team.

For a start I propose to engage in conversation in the new “Deployment Working Group” category. Go to <https://discourse.nixos.org/c/dev/deployments-working-group> 13 and select “Tracking” to be notified of new messages in the group.
